blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY , Oriental Mindoro — The Mimaropa police has arrested a total of 509 “most wanted persons” across the region from January 1 to October 12, including the second most wanted fugitive for murder who was apprehended in Puerto Princesa City in Palawan. The top fugitive was taken into custody at around 11 a.m. on October 12 by personnel of Police Station 4 of the Puerto Princesa City Police Office, on the strength of a warrant from the Roxas Regional Trial Court Branch 164 for murder.
